title: GitHub Issues bridge
hypothesis: Mirroring the internal backlog to GitHub Issues will make autonomous work visible and steerable.

title: Optional LLM planner adapter
hypothesis: A provider-neutral LLM adapter can improve idea generation without making secrets mandatory.

title: Experiment benchmark ledger
hypothesis: Tracking expected versus observed outcomes will improve future prioritization decisions.

title: Isolated experiment sandbox
hypothesis: A constrained subprocess sandbox will let experiments execute while keeping side effects explicit.

title: Backlog replenishment gate
hypothesis: A deterministic, validated replenishment gate can keep the autonomous loop moving without allowing generated ideas to bypass repository safety constraints.

title: Planner calibration checkpoint
hypothesis: Five completed outcomes are enough to inspect systematic planner bias before considering any scoring-weight change.

title: Sandbox capability manifests
hypothesis: Named capability manifests can make allowed experiment commands easier to audit without weakening the sandbox allowlist.

title: Journal synthesis snapshot
hypothesis: A deterministic synthesis of completed experiments can surface repeated lessons and missing capabilities without making the journal less auditable.

title: Planner ranking quality checkpoint
hypothesis: Despite systematic underprediction of absolute outcome scores, the deterministic planner still orders experiments usefully enough to keep the relative feature weights unchanged.

title: Planner intercept calibration
hypothesis: A simple additive intercept estimated from prior residuals can improve absolute calibration without changing candidate ordering or relative feature weights.

title: Frozen calibration holdout baseline
hypothesis: Freezing the additive intercept before later outcomes arrive will provide cleaner evidence about whether absolute-score calibration generalizes.

title: Declarative candidate registry
hypothesis: A declarative candidate registry can make future backlog replenishment auditable and extensible without requiring source-code edits for every new generation.

title: Elaine Mission Radar
hypothesis: A deterministic user-facing mission portfolio can turn Lumen into a practical collaborator by selecting one concrete high-leverage next action without network, model, or secret dependencies.

title: Elaine focused work sessions
hypothesis: A deterministic focused session with ordered steps, local progress, and a Definition of Done can turn Mission Radar recommendations into practical work without adding autonomous external execution.

title: State integrity doctor
hypothesis: A deterministic cross-file integrity check can catch drift between backlog, outcomes, calibration baselines, and generated snapshots before autonomous work builds on inconsistent state.

title: Experiment provenance index
hypothesis: A local provenance index linking experiments to evidence artifacts can make completed work easier to audit without making GitHub or generated summaries a source of truth.

title: State schema versioning
hypothesis: Explicit schema versions and deterministic migrations can let Lumen evolve its persisted state without silent compatibility failures.
